scope: Read-only authored source and actual Rust consumer contract comparison; no source edits, native reruns, GitHub reviews, or merge mutation.
conclusion: The main compiler-bump commit changes application contracts as well as the compiler pin. Directly adopting its authored source would break existing consumers. Preserve the stack's current contracts and adjudicate additive intent separately; never hand-merge generated Rust or receipts.

findings.severity: blocking if main source is copied
findings.main_change: filterlist/filterKey/focus-filter replaced by searchlist/keyFrom/Find; contextAt, reconcile, revealGeometry and scroll projection removed.
findings.impact: Current search/preset dispatch uses seven-argument filterKey with composition and modifier facts, and current menu/track bridges depend on reveal/context/reconcile. Main contains no matching Rust migration. The new checked-menu selection/chooseSelection contract must also survive.

findings.severity: blocking if main source is copied
findings.main_change: keyMode/table-point renamed to keyboardMode/vertical-step and exposed key method removed.
findings.impact: Current native scalar dispatch still calls key and publishes keyMode. Adopting main disconnects delegated key admission and can restore traversal keys to scalar writes.

findings.main_change: commandMode and command event replaced by commands and audioKey return-value method; Escape result changed from clear-range to escape.
findings.impact: Current editor surface uses source command event delivery and commandMode authority; it does not call the added audioKey API.

findings.severity: blocking if main source is copied
findings.main_change: keyInput and revealGeometry methods, reveal authority props, and horizontal projection removed; focus guard moved into public key method.
findings.impact: The host's explicit fallback and deferred geometry transports still call these methods. Stack's event path already leaves descendant editing keys alone while explicit calls serve the documented fallback.

findings.severity: blocking if main source is copied
findings.main_change: submitOnEnter, submit event and requestContext method removed, together with press-generation and live-text separation guards.
findings.impact: Existing form/default-response consumers still publish submitOnEnter and drain submit. The held-source authority guard and stack's exclusive radio/tab true proposals must remain.

findings.severity: blocking if main source is copied
findings.main_change: Physical keyDown and pointer press.start no longer emit trigger for momentary controls; momentary policy change no longer retires press.
findings.impact: The real piano-roll audition key is momentary. Its delivery intentionally skips pressedChange and relies on trigger, so main source would silence physical momentary activation while assistive activation could still work.

input_hook_finding.main_change: Flattens asInputEditor plus asInputRoot into one asInputRoot, then makes direct text-field use the latter.
input_hook_finding.verified: The stack already retains the full asInputRoot ControlLabel target at upstream-input/root.proto.ts:246-255, including disabled, request.isCurrent, and pointer/programmatic focus reason. Main moves that same behavior into the single hook; it does not introduce a capability absent from the stack.
input_hook_finding.profile: Pinned e934 targets.ts:512-516 explicitly admits ControlLabel operations. No unsupported-profile claim is made.
input_hook_finding.consumer: Search across app Rust and authored sources found no independent Label association consumer; text-field composes directly named editing through asInputEditor and has an explicit provenance/test boundary for that choice. Rust does not refer to either hook's name.
input_hook_finding.recommendation: Preserve the exact recorded official vendor snapshot and its two hooks. This retains real asInputRoot Label capability without forcing a separate Label association onto directly named fields.

additive_intent.space_prevention: Main adds an early key.down Space default-prevention line. Stack already requests default prevention from press.commit in the same native keydown; SDK global_key_down at gpui-native-owner.rs:1144-1153 preserves semantic press when a key default is prevented. This small source-level intent can be considered independently with existing authority guards; it does not justify wholesale main Action replacement.
additive_intent.graph_point: Main graph-point source change only joins the previousRevision declaration onto one line.
additive_intent.tests: No source/native tests were run in this review. Existing frozen-head CI remains attached to those heads; the reconciled candidate needs its own producer and runtime evidence.
